verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is a card-issuing payment infrastructure API, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes external tools; the evidence shows Stripe offers its own MCP server for others to call into (docs-16, probe-4), which is the opposite direction from the story. There is no concept of Stripe Issuing itself acting as an MCP client plugging in external tool servers, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
